mentions.name: MyVisualRoutine
mentions.description: An app for creating full visual routines for non-verbal children in about 20 seconds and taking them anywhere, with choice boards, First/Then boards, day plans, 50+ preloaded activities, and full offline support. Available on iOS and Android with a genuinely usable free tier.
mentions.problem: Physical visual schedules (laminated cards, velcro boards) are a lifeline for non-verbal children, but they are a nightmare to manage and don't leave the house.
mentions.audience: Families and caregivers of non-verbal children, including the author's own family.
mentions.source_excerpt: MyVisualRoutine ( https://myvisualroutine.com ) — This one is personal. I have three kids, two with severe disabilities. Visual schedules (laminated cards, velcro boards) are a lifeline for non-verbal children, but they're a nightmare to manage and they don't leave the house. So I built an app that lets you create a full visual routine in about 20 seconds and take it anywhere. Choice boards, First/Then boards, day plans, 50+ preloaded activities, works fully offline. Free tier is genuinely usable. Available on iOS and Android.
